$doc: The Android app's tokens (ADR-0065 §5, design/mobile.md §A.8), set under :root[data-platform='android'] in dist/platform-android.css. Only the phone app loads that file, so the browser's CSS never carries it. Numbers are Material 3's (m3.material.io), each with its spec in `spec`; colours are derived from wisp's own (var(--accent), var(--bg), …), so light and dark follow tokens.css. Names shared with tokens.css (--radius-xs…xl, --bar-h) override the browser value inside the app only, on purpose; no other name may collide (test/platform.test.ts). The tonal surfaces are --surface-c0…c4 (§A.8's --surface-0…4) and the rail --nav-rail-w, because tokens.css's --surface-2 and the stage's --rail-w already mean something else.

row-h-2.spec: M3 Lists › Specs: two-line list item 72 dp

row-h-3.spec: M3 Lists › Specs: three-line list item 88 dp

inset.spec: M3 Lists › Specs: leading and trailing padding 16 dp

radius-md.spec: M3 Shape › Corner radius scale: medium 12 dp

radius-lg.spec: M3 Shape › Corner radius scale: large 16 dp

radius-sheet.spec: M3 Bottom sheets › Specs: top corners 28 dp (extra large)

radius-dialog.spec: M3 Dialogs › Specs: container shape 28 dp (extra large)

type-label-s.spec: M3 Type scale: label small 11/16 w500, tracking 0.5

track-title-s.spec: M3 Type scale: title small tracking 0.1

track-body-m.spec: M3 Type scale: body medium tracking 0.25

track-body-s.spec: M3 Type scale: body small tracking 0.4

track-label-m.spec: M3 Type scale: label medium tracking 0.5

track-label-s.spec: M3 Type scale: label small tracking 0.5

surface-c0.spec: M3 Color roles: surface (and surface container lowest) = wisp's page

surface-c1.spec: M3 Elevation › Tonal elevation level 1: primary at 5% over surface (surface container low)

surface-c3.spec: M3 tonal elevation level 3: 11% (surface container high)

surface-c4.spec: M3 tonal elevation level 5: 14% (surface container highest)

on-surface.spec: M3 Color roles: on surface = wisp's ink

on-surface-var.spec: M3 Color roles: on surface variant = wisp's muted

outline.spec: M3 Color roles: outline (≥ 3:1 for control boundaries) = wisp's faint (4.5:1)

outline-var.spec: M3 Color roles: outline variant (decorative dividers) = wisp's line

primary.spec: M3 Color roles: primary = wisp's accent (dynamic colour off, ADR-0065 open question 4)

primary-container.spec: M3 Color roles: primary container (tonal buttons, the nav bar's active indicator)

on-primary-container.spec: M3 Color roles: on primary container

error.spec: M3 Color roles: error = wisp's bad

ease-emph.spec: M3 Motion › Easing: emphasized (the CSS fallback for its path)

swipe-line.spec: v1's swipe threshold: a third of the row (design/mobile.md §A.4)

grabber-w.spec: M3 Bottom sheets › Specs: drag handle 32 × 4 dp

grabber-h.spec: M3 Bottom sheets › Specs: drag handle 32 × 4 dp

safe-top.spec: edge-to-edge (Android 15 enforces it): the status bar

safe-bottom.spec: edge-to-edge: the gesture bar or the 3-button bar
